# The mountain peak the pagoda stands on: three faceted rocky frustums rising out of the clouds to a
# small grassy plateau (top at z 0, 4.4 m across). Up Z.
new
add mesh cone --name Top --vertices 9 --radius1 2.7 --radius2 2.2 --depth 1.2 --cap-fill ngon --location 0 0 -0.6
add mesh cone --name Mid --vertices 9 --radius1 3.9 --radius2 2.75 --depth 2.4 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 -2.4 --rotation 0 0 17
add mesh cone --name Low --vertices 9 --radius1 5.4 --radius2 3.95 --depth 3.6 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 -5.4 --rotation 0 0 5
material new Rock --base-color 0.604 0.388 0.282
select Top Mid Low
material assign Rock
active Mid
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.18 --seed 11
mode object
active Low
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.25 --seed 12
mode object
active Top
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.95"
delete face
select face where "normal.z > 0.95"
material new Grass --base-color 0.392 0.490 0.204 --no-slot
material assign Grass
mode object
select all
shade flat
export peak.glb
